DECLARE @AMMEX_GP_Extenal_ID__c CHAR(51) = TRIM(?), @Picklist_Value CHAR(133) = TRIM(?)
IF @AMMEX_GP_Extenal_ID__c<>'' BEGIN /*DECLARE @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID BIGINT = NULL, @EXTENDER_WINDOW_ID char(15) = 'CUSTOMER2'
----------Find if there are any Record of Customer from Source Data in WINDOW_ID above------------------ SELECT @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID = Extender_Record_ID FROM EXT01100 WITH(NOLOCK) --STORES ALL RECORDS IN EXTENDER TABLE WHERE Extender_Window_ID = RTRIM(@EXTENDER_WINDOW_ID) AND Extender_Key_Values_1 = RTRIM(@AMMEX_GP_Extenal_ID__c)
IF @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID IS NULL BEGIN INSERT INTO EXT01100 ( Extender_Record_ID, Extender_Window_ID, Extender_Key_Values_1, Extender_Key_Values_2, Extender_Key_Values_3, Extender_Key_Values_4, Extender_Key_Values_5, NOTEINDX, MODIFDT, MDFUSRID, CREATDDT, CRUSRId ) VALUES( (SELECT MAX(Extender_Record_ID) + 1 FROM EXT01100), -- Extender_Record_ID RTRIM(@EXTENDER_WINDOW_ID), -- Extender_Window_ID RTRIM(@AMMEX_GP_Extenal_ID__c), -- Extender_Key_Values_1 '', -- Extender_Key_Values_2 '', -- Extender_Key_Values_3 '', -- Extender_Key_Values_4 '', -- Extender_Key_Values_5 '0.00', -- NOTEINDX DATEADD(d,DATEDIFF(d,0,getdate()),0), -- MODIFDT 'BOOMI', -- MDFUSRID DATEADD(d,DATEDIFF(d,0,getdate()),0), -- CREATDDT 'BOOMI' -- CRUSRId )
SELECT @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID = Extender_Record_ID FROM EXT01100 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE Extender_Window_ID = RTRIM(@EXTENDER_WINDOW_ID) AND Extender_Key_Values_1 = RTRIM(@AMMEX_GP_Extenal_ID__c) END */
DECLARE @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID BIGINT = NULL, @EXTENDER_WINDOW_ID CHAR(15) = 'CUSTOMER2', @USRID CHAR(15) = 'BOOMI', @RetryCount INT = 0, @MaxRetries INT = 3;
WHILE @RetryCount < @MaxRetries BEGIN BEGIN TRY
SET @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID = NULL;
EXEC CREATE_EXTENDER_HEADER @EXTENDER_WINDOW_ID, @AMMEX_GP_Extenal_ID__c, '', '', '', '', @USRID, @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID OUTPUT;
IF @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID IS NULL BEGIN THROW 50001, 'Extender Record ID is null', 1; END
PRINT 'Success - Extender Record ID: ' + CAST(@EXTENDER_RECORD_ID AS VARCHAR);
BREAK;
END TRY BEGIN CATCH
SET @RetryCount += 1;
PRINT 'Retry attempt: ' + CAST(@RetryCount AS VARCHAR);
IF @RetryCount >= @MaxRetries BEGIN THROW; END
WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:02';
END CATCH END ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @FieldName char(31) = 'Sales Partner', @EXTENDER_FIELD_ID int = NULL
------------------------Find the ID of the FIELD Above--------------- SELECT @EXTENDER_FIELD_ID=Field_ID FROM EXT20010 --STORES ALL FIELD DETAILS WHERE EXT20010.FIELDNAM LIKE '%'+@FieldName+'%'
IF @EXTENDER_FIELD_ID IS NULL BEGIN raiserror('Field ID for [Sales Partner] is not found.', 16,2) END ---------------------------------------------------------------------
DECLARE @Picklist_List_ID int = NULL
---------------Find the ID of the Picklist Value from Source Data---------------
IF @Picklist_Value='' OR @Picklist_Value IS NULL BEGIN SET @Picklist_Value = '(blank)' END
SELECT @Picklist_List_ID=Extender_List_Item_ID FROM EXT20021 INNER JOIN EXT20010 ON EXT20021.Extender_List_ID = EXT20010.Extender_List_ID WHERE STRNG132 LIKE '%'+@Picklist_Value+'%' AND EXT20010.Field_ID=@EXTENDER_FIELD_ID
IF @Picklist_List_ID IS NULL BEGIN raiserror('[Sales Partner] option is not found in the Picklist', 16,2) END ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
----------Stored Procedure to UPSERT Picklist in any Extender Table/Window------------ EXEC EXTENDER_UPSERT_EXT01103 @EXTENDER_RECORD_ID,@EXTENDER_FIELD_ID,@Picklist_List_ID -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- END
